import os,runpy,sys
os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:4])
os.nice(19-os.getpriority(os.PRIO_PROCESS,0))
import torch
torch.set_num_threads(1)
torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(0.12,0)
from sarbench.data import SARImages
original_getitem=SARImages.__getitem__
def logged_getitem(self,index):
    result=original_getitem(self,index)
    if (index+1)%200==0 or index+1==len(self):
        print(f'INPUT_IMAGES_LOADED {index+1}/{len(self)}',flush=True)
    return result
SARImages.__getitem__=logged_getitem
sys.argv=['predict.py']+sys.argv[1:]
runpy.run_path('predict.py',run_name='__main__')
print('PREDICTOR_PEAK_GPU_GIB',torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated()/2**30,flush=True)
